verdict.rationale: First-party docs clearly cover the hardware media engines. NVENC handles H.264, HEVC and AV1, with improved HEVC/AV1 quality and roughly 3x throughput versus software AV1. Blackwell adds 4:2:2 H.264/HEVC encode and decode, and the vendor positions the card for livestreaming, real-time editing and broadcast. Creator-app acceleration is supported only by a generic claim that over 100 professional and creative applications leverage RTX, plus mentions of film, animation and virtual-production workflows. missing for 10: any evidence of professional/ISV-certified driver support, named creator applications with documented acceleration, independent or hands-on corroboration of encoder quality/performance.
